scope: 99 Python source files / 19,317 lines, 70 test files, task configuration, examples, distribution scripts, integration patches and current guides
mode: Read-only code review with small reproductions. No runtime/source/config/doc edits or deletions. Prior 439-pass suite was not rerun for this review.
conclusion: 整理の中心は、設定・数値データ・学習済みgeometry/layout・評価measure・保存互換性の正本をそれぞれ一つにすることです。単体実行内で検証やシリアライズを繰り返す一方、実際の入力不整合を見逃す経路が残っています。

priority_definitions.P1: 誤動作または継続運用への影響があり、最初に対応する候補
priority_definitions.P2: 責務・性能・拡張性を改善する構造整理
priority_definitions.P3: 動作の所有者を確定した後に行う局所クリーンアップ

findings.title: YAMLの手法設定typoが別手法へ化けて正常完了する
findings.reproduction: representation.decompostion.name=dct2 was accepted by the direct task and saved a pod_svd model; FieldRepresentation rejects the same unknown key.
findings.impact: A successful run can execute a method the user did not request.
findings.action: CLI/task/Pythonで同じrepresentation resolverを使います。未知keyを捨てるtask側の4要素再構築を削除し、既定値・params展開を一箇所で解決します。
findings.retain: Necessary unknown-method/shape/finite checks at the public boundary; no new parallel contract registry.

findings.title: 表示・出典metadataが数値geometryの同一性に混入している
findings.reproduction: Array constructor with supplied x/y and NPY loader with the same explicit axes produce identical coordinates and weights but different hashes due to coordinate_source metadata. A fitted DCT rejects the other Dataset.
findings.impact: Equivalent Python and YAML inputs cannot be used interchangeably.
findings.action: 数値座標・topology・mask・積分measureと意味のある単位／境界からidentityを定義し、出典・説明・表示metadataを外します。配列の所有・変更規則を決めずにhashを永続cacheする方法は避けます。
findings.retain: Real geometry/unit/topology mismatch detection. Avoid caching identity on mutable arrays without defining ownership.

findings.title: Dataset IDの存在だけでローカル内容の同一性確認を省略する
findings.reproduction: Two local field.npy arrays differing by +1 have the same revision when manifest and clearml_dataset_id match.
findings.impact: Strict Stage/split checks do not detect this local content change. An adapter-resolved immutable Dataset is a different case.
findings.action: ローカル内容から一度だけ数値identityを確定します。自由記入のremote IDはprovenanceに限定し、解決済みremote snapshotの不変保証はadapter境界で所有します。
findings.delete_candidate: Unconditional content-hash omission on presence of data.clearml_dataset_id.

findings.title: 対応済みのsingleton軸FFTがモードmetadata生成で失敗する
findings.reproduction: FFT fit/reconstruction works for NHWC (1,1,8,1) and (1,8,1,1), but list_modes([0]) raises IndexError from x[0,1] or y[1,0].
findings.action: singleton/index軸で定義したgeometryの意味を周波数表示でも使います。taskごとの例外補修を増やさず、手法の適用条件とモード解析の対応範囲を揃えます。
findings.retain: Independent real FFT coordinates, norm and conjugate-symmetry invariants.

findings.title: 明示した疎符号化アルゴリズム・内積が自動変更される
findings.reproduction: OMP requested with 12 components, 8 samples and 16 features resolves to lasso_cd. Direct sklearn sparse_encode with the same dimensions and OMP returns finite (8,12) coefficients with at most two nonzeros. POD also falls back from requested domain_weights to euclidean if weights are absent.
findings.impact: Comparison may execute a different algorithm or inner product from the declared setting; warnings/effective metadata do not remove the semantic change.
findings.action: 明示されたアルゴリズム・内積を実行するか、実際に非対応な条件を説明して停止します。任意のOMP→Lasso切替・重みなしへのfallbackを外し、PODのprojection準備を共通化します。
findings.retain: Effective solver/inner-product/rank/energy metadata that explains the actual mathematics.

findings.confidence: contract reproduced; compatibility of genuine old bundles not established
findings.title: モデルの利用可否を全runtime packageの完全一致で決めている
findings.reproduction: The same current joblib with its sidecar's mode version changed from 0.7.1 to 0.7.0 is rejected solely by the version mismatch.
findings.impact: Every patch upgrade can require old environments or retraining without assessing bundle-format compatibility.
findings.action: 再現用runtime記録とロード可否の判定を分離します。bundle schema・移行方針を明示し、実際に過去版で保存したbundleで互換受入を行います。sklearn/joblibの任意版間互換を仮定して検査全体を外してはいけません。
findings.retain: Artifact integrity and backend-specific compatibility checks. Do not assume arbitrary sklearn/joblib versions are compatible or simply disable all version checks.

findings.title: 同一ローカル実行のStageごとにDataset読込・コピー・検証を繰り返す
findings.reproduction: For 20 samples and two candidates: four Dataset loads, 16 FieldDataset constructions, finite checks traversing 156 sample instances. Subsets do not share field memory. File hashes do have a stat cache; full repeated file hashing was not observed.
findings.action: Dataset・確定split/CV folds・評価measureを一つのローカル実行contextに持たせます。subsetはindex viewとしbackend境界だけで配列化します。外部Stage／再開時のdeserialize・整合検査はadapterで行います。
findings.move_candidate: ArtifactRef/path/config roundtrips, release/workspace/publication comparison and transport validation to Stage/SDK adapters.
findings.retain: Input validation and actual train/selection/calibration/test isolation, fresh fold fits and partial failure results.

findings.title: 単一の固定候補でも選択用holdoutと2回のfitを要求する
findings.action: tuningなしの事前固定1候補はproper train→任意calibration→testとします。実際に選択・探索を行う目的にだけselection/CVを導入します。
findings.delete_candidate: Unconditional candidate-selection Stage and selection score for this fixed-model case.
findings.retain: Selection isolation for multiple candidates/HPO and calibration reserved before selection.

findings.title: モデルを保存しない比較でもサイズ診断のため毎回全体をserializeする
findings.impact: A full BytesIO model copy per candidate/repetition, plus a second serialization when save_models is true. Pickling becomes a success requirement for a non-saving scientific comparison.
findings.action: model_bytesのための必須BytesIO dumpを廃止します。明示保存時は実artifactからサイズを取り、保存しない場合は未測定とします。
findings.retain: Explicit model persistence and independent saved-model prediction tests.

findings.title: 散布点追加評価でI/O・写像・support・捨てるfield scoreを再計算する
findings.impact: Each candidate/baseline/repetition reloads the full canonical Dataset and compressed observations, reconstructs maps per sample, repeats reverse support tests, and computes a field score the caller discards.
findings.action: 準備済みreference・元観測・写像を追加evaluatorへ渡し、往復誤差とsupportはsampleごとに一度だけ計算します。必要なsampleだけを読み、callerが捨てるfield再採点を削除します。
findings.retain: Continuous support checks for walls/holes and the original observation mask; do not remove the recent correctness fix.

findings.title: 散布点取込で全sampleを保持し、stack/concatenateで配列を重複させる
findings.action: CSV importerと同様の逐次NPY書込に揃え、共有point/grid mapを再利用します。元観測は対象sample範囲だけ読み出せる保存にし、atomicな出力確定は維持します。
findings.delete_candidate: Whole-run packed/converted/supported lists followed by stack/concatenate copies; point_scores(values,values,...) used only as an input validator.
findings.retain: Atomic final rename, source immutability and real observation validation.

findings.title: 旧sample/channel adapterと暗黙の係数補修が数値層を複雑にする
findings.reproduction: NoOpCoeffCodec.decode([10], coeff_shape=[2,2]) silently yields [[10,0],[0,0]]. The high-level inverse already requires the exact packed dimension, so this is a lower-level permissive behavior rather than a demonstrated high-level corruption.
findings.action: 数値入力をbatch配列・共通／sample別mask・geometryへ揃えます。joint/channelwiseの数学的違いは残し、SimpleNamespaceやsample再生成を外します。layoutとcodecをfit時に確定し、モード選択のゼロ化は明示APIが所有します。
findings.delete_candidate: Implicit short-vector padding in generic codec/decomposer paths after checking callers, factory-dropping pickle workarounds and duplicate metadata dispatch.
findings.retain: Intentional Fourier low-pass reconstruction, explicit selected-mode zeros and genuine wavelet/offset structures.

findings.title: POD・前処理・評価を通したメモリ上限のある処理になっていない
findings.action: 中心化・重み・mask射影・backend mechanicsを共通化し、中心化有無／joint／欠測手法は分けて残します。読込・前処理・encoding・採点までbatch化し、同じ評価measureを再利用します。
findings.impact: IncrementalPCA's batch solver does not by itself prevent whole-field materialization, subset copies or repeated float64/mask/error arrays.
findings.delete_candidate: Unnecessary all-valid np.where copies and repeated same-reference measure/hash/report setup.
findings.caveat: No large-data memory benchmark was run; this is based on explicit allocation and call paths.

findings.title: モードの数学的意味を中央の手法名whitelistで推定している
findings.impact: Adding a new nonlinear decomposer to the catalog can be classified as additive unless another central special-case list is updated.
findings.action: 各学習済み手法が少数のsynthesis分類と安定layoutを公開します。未知のsynthesisは加法的と断定せず摂動として扱います。大きなplugin／契約frameworkは追加しません。
findings.retain: A/Z distinction, nonlinear reference semantics and FFT physical labels.

findings.title: fieldのkind・unitsを入力形式ごとのmanifest辞書に埋めている
findings.reproduction: Whitespace-only field units are accepted by array construction plus DCT fit, but rejected by the NPY loader.
findings.action: FieldDatasetに正規化したkind/components/unitsを属性として持たせ、manifestは出典記録に限定します。形式ごとのadapterで一度だけ意味を解決し、複数のunits parserを統合します。
findings.delete_candidate: Synthetic partial manifests for array input and duplicate units parsers with different rules.
findings.retain: Component ordering, declared vector semantics and mixed-unit metric scaling.

findings.title: 数値geometryが入力adapterとは別にファイルI/Oと旧alias解決を行う
findings.reproduction: geometry.vertex_mask_path=vertices_mask.npy fails from cwd even when the file exists under data.local_path; mask aliases are not consistently resolved/copied by import.
findings.action: 参照解決・読込・コピーをinput adapterに集約し、数値geometryは配列を受け取ります。旧mask/mesh path aliasはcanonical形式への移行境界へ隔離・退役します。
findings.retain: Canonical masks.domain/mesh input, geometry shape and positive-measure checks.

findings.title: 一部のraw入力に不要なsample表・array_indexの準備を要求する
findings.action: NPY散布点は既知のNから位置ID/indexを生成し、raw CSVは宣言した行順を既定にします。複数fileや外部条件の対応付けに必要な場合だけ明示mappingを使います。
findings.retain: ID uniqueness and condition/field correspondence when the user supplies IDs or indices.

findings.title: 通常開発・buildと過去SDK統合資材の責務が混ざっている
findings.action: coreの固定配布元を用意し、通常のmode buildとcore再構築を分けます。SDK準備は一つの対象版へ更新するまで歴史資材として隔離します。通常検査とrelease smokeの小さい継続実行入口に整理します。
findings.impact: Current platform preparation mixes old task definitions with new source and omits current guides/examples; the default build clones/patches core even for mode-only changes.
findings.retain: Clean source staging for wheels and historical patches/logs. Python 3.11/GPU acceptance is still separate from the current 3.12 CPU result.

checks_to_keep: Independent real FFT coordinate/norm/conjugacy and arbitrary regression-output realness.
Hodge incidence, manufactured exact/coexact/harmonic, native weighted orthogonality/energy and node sampling residual.
Corrected finite-sample conformal rank and simultaneous versus pointwise semantics.
Changing calibration/test truth does not affect candidate selection or point predictions.
Fresh transforms within CV folds; actual group/time/gap boundaries.
Scattered thin-wall/hole/missing-mask/read-only-mask regressions and original source immutability.
Field/condition/ID correspondence, observed-value finiteness, positive physical measure and component/unit meaning.
Independent saved-model inference and failure without incomplete Dataset/model publication.
Two broad import-direction rules separating SDK/business and numerics/execution.
Wheel source-set/bytes check at release time only; it is not a normal runtime contract.

cleanup_of_review_assets.issue: Historical evidence and reusable validation workflows share hardcoded work-directory layouts.
cleanup_of_review_assets.action: Keep historical JSON/CSV and required source inputs. Move only experiments intended for continued use into one small input/output-parameterized maintained entry. Before-fix evidence should not depend on executing a removed old wheel.
preserve: Original user review and pre-implementation patch
Integration patches/logs until integration is intentionally resumed

implementation_order: 入力の意味を先に統一する: 設定resolver、数値geometry identity、field kind/units、明示アルゴリズム、singletonモードmetadata。
Dataset・split/folds・評価measureをローカルで一度だけ準備する。外部Stageの復元・来歴・公開・整合検査はadapterへ集約。
数値batch・projection・layoutの所有者を揃え、必須シリアライズ・捨てる再評価・全sample bufferingを外す。
実bundleによる保存互換方針を確定し、runtime/metadata完全一致を固定するテストを移動・置換する。
未使用helper／placeholderを削除候補として確定し、重複テストとrelease QAを統合。歴史的証跡と継続toolを分離。
important_limits: No existing method or numerical invariant should be removed solely because it is long or has many tests.
Centered versus noncentered POD, joint versus per-channel modes and missing-data algorithms are mathematically distinct even when implementation can be shared.
The exact-version reproduction changed sidecar metadata; it did not establish compatibility of genuine older serialized bundles.
Allocation/call-path findings are not a measured large-dataset timing or peak-memory benchmark.
This review intentionally identifies candidates without applying them.
